scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance For Patent Registration /Trade Mark Registration
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: The applicant must be an individual, a new manufacturing/service unit, or an existing manufacturing/service unit undertaking expansion or diversification in the MSME sector.
The unit must have commenced commercial production between 20‑05‑2022 and 19‑05‑2027.
The applicant must apply within one year from the date of publication/notification of the patent or trademark.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 75% reimbursement of patent or trademark registration costs, capped at ₹25,00,000 per applicant, with attorney fee limits of ₹50,000 for national patents and ₹2,00,000 per country for international patents.
